usage: 肥皂 (fei4 zou6) means soap and is used to clean your body or hands.
In a sentence, 肥皂 can be the subject, object, or part of a prepositional phrase.
You can say 我用緊肥皂洗手 (I am using soap to wash my hands).
肥皂 can describe different types of soap like 香皂 (fragrant soap) or 洗手肥皂 (hand soap).
It usually refers to solid soap, but sometimes it can mean liquid soap too if the context is clear.
